Ltd.) - **Websites:** [www.funnelkit.com](https://www.funnelkit.com) | [www.sublium.com](https://www.sublium.com) - **Location:** Remote (candidates across the globe can apply) - **Employment type:** Full-time, permanent - **Experience:** 3+ years building and running AI/ML or LLM-based features inside production software used by paying customers (prototypes alone do not count) - **Education:** B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or a related field, or an equivalent strong engineering background. Proficiency in Python, PostgreSQL and TypeScript is required. - **Working days and hours:** 5 days, Monday to Friday ## About FunnelKit FunnelKit builds powerful no-code funnel and marketing automation products for businesses worldwide. Our mission is to help small businesses grow profitably by giving them the right tools to increase conversions and revenue, without unnecessary complexity. We are a product-first, customer-driven team that values ownership, simplicity, kindness, and excellence. ## Role Overview This role is ideal for someone who: - Treats AI as an engineering discipline: you design for results a store owner can rely on, and you test that reliability instead of stopping once the model responds. - Has spent 3+ years putting AI/ML and LLM features in front of paying customers in a live product. - Picks up an ambiguous problem, decides how to attack it, and delivers without close direction. - Writes and speaks clear English, and can walk engineers, designers, product managers and support colleagues through a technical trade-off. At FunnelKit and Sublium, AI sits inside the tools merchants use every day: suggesting funnel and checkout improvements, drafting email and on-site copy, grouping customers into segments, and automating routine marketing work. You will build these capabilities, along with the internal AI tooling our own teams use for reporting and decision support. You will carry a project from first data exploration through model choice, evaluation, API and interface work, release and production monitoring, working daily with Product, Engineering, Design, QA and Customer Success. ## Key Responsibilities **Build AI Features for Merchants** - Ship AI capabilities inside FunnelKit and Sublium, such as funnel and checkout recommendations, email and SMS copy drafting, customer segmentation, revenue forecasting and agent-style automations. - Take a merchant's goal and store data and produce suggestions concrete enough to act on. After launch, study real usage and plan the next iteration. - Agree success metrics and event tracking with the Product Manager before you build. **Design the LLM Layer** - Create prompt templates, schema-validated responses, tool calls, retrieval (RAG) and safety checks, and chain them into multi-step agent flows where they add value. - Compare models, frameworks and hosting options for each use case against quality, response time and spend. - Add fallback providers, response caching and spend limits so features stay dependable at scale. **Work with Data** - Prepare imperfect store, funnel and event data for analysis and for use as model input. - Anchor generated text to real figures from the merchant's account, so AI output never contains invented numbers. - Run the pipelines that collect, transform and serve this data to AI features and internal reports. **Measure and Protect Quality** - Build evaluation sets and monitoring so you can show that each release beats the previous one and catch regressions before merchants do. - Report quality, latency and per-request cost on dashboards shared with the team. - Help QA design tests for output that changes from run to run. **Own Delivery End to End** - Implement the backend services (Python or TypeScript) and the TypeScript and React interface that carry a result to the merchant, and deploy them. **Build Internal AI Tools** - Create AI-assisted reporting, analytics and workflow tools for Support, Marketing and Product teams, simple enough that non-engineers use them without help. **Engineering Habits and Sharing** - Deliver tested, maintainable code with error handling, logging and tracing. - Use AI coding assistants daily, and check their output before it is merged. - Write down how each solution works and how AI helped build it, so colleagues can reuse the approach. - Follow developments in models and tooling, and propose what is worth adopting. **Collaboration and Customer Support** - Work with Product, Design, QA and Customer Success to turn customer problems into improvements. - Set privacy, safety and compliance rules for AI features, with legal and security input where needed. - Make features explainable to L1/L2 support teams, and help diagnose serious production problems. ## Required Skills and Experience - **Production AI experience:** 3+ years shipping ML or LLM-based functionality that customers actually use. Prototypes and hackathon projects alone are not enough. - **Python (required):** production-quality code with tests, type annotations, packaging and async where it fits. - **TypeScript (required):** production-quality TypeScript with strict typing and tests, for Node.js services and for React interfaces. - **Full-stack range:** comfortable on both sides, with backend services in Python or Node.js and interfaces in React. You may lean toward one side. - **LLM engineering:** prompting, structured outputs, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, guardrails and measuring output quality. - **Frameworks and retrieval:** LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or comparable tools, plus embeddings and vector stores (for example Pinecone, Chroma, FAISS or Qdrant). You can build a retrieval pipeline without a framework. - **ML foundation:** you understand how models behave, when fine-tuning beats prompting, and how to evaluate fairly. - **Data:** SQL and pandas or Spark, and experience with unclean production data. - **Services and infrastructure:** building and deploying APIs (FastAPI, Flask or similar), working knowledge of Cloudflare, AWS, GCP or Azure, Docker, and familiarity with Kubernetes. - **Workflow:** Git and GitHub with pull-request reviews, and daily use of AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) with a clear account of how you verify their output. - **Judgement:** product sense (you care whether a feature is used and moves a metric), skill at diagnosing production failures, and a preference for simple designs. - **Communication:** strong written and spoken English, clear documentation, and the ability to explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. - **Remote requirement:** must be able to work remotely, reliable internet and availability for meetings during agreed hours. ## Education - B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or related fields (or an equivalent strong engineering background). - Certifications in AI/ML or data are a plus but not mandatory. ## Current Work Profile (What We Expect to See) Candidates should currently be working, or have recent experience, as one of the following, with demonstrable impact: - AI Engineer, Applied AI Engineer or ML Engineer in a B2B SaaS or product company. - Full-stack or backend engineer who has shipped LLM-powered features (RAG, agents or similar) in a production product. - Software engineer driving AI-powered internal tools or data platforms in a software or product organisation. In your application, please highlight: - Specific AI features you have shipped (what, how, impact), and how you measured output quality. - Your current or most recent role, scope, tech stack and the type of product or company. - Links to GitHub, demos, case studies or public write-ups if available. ## Nice-to-Have Skills - Marketing technology context: marketing automation, personalisation or conversion optimisation. - Generating more than text, such as page layouts, designs or publish-ready assets. - Evaluation tooling such as Langfuse, DeepEval or RAGAS, or pipelines that use a model as the judge. - Agent orchestration (CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen) and tool integration through MCP. - Cost efficiency work, including fine-tuning with LoRA, QLoRA or PEFT, and quantisation. - MLOps practice: experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases), drift monitoring, and platforms such as Databricks or SageMaker. - Building internal tools that non-technical colleagues rely on. - Public work: open-source contributions, papers or technical articles. - Prior experience in a remote-first or globally distributed team. ## Why This Role is Exciting - **Product Impact:** Build AI features that directly affect revenue and growth for thousands of WooCommerce businesses. - **AI-First Mandate:** AI is part of our core products and strategy, not a bolt-on, and you will shape how it is built. - **Full Ownership:** Own AI projects from data and model choice to the interface and production monitoring. - **Cross-Product Thinking:** Work across an ecosystem of products, not siloed features. - **Modern Engineering:** AI-enhanced workflows, continuous improvement and a quality-first culture. - **Global Reach:** Your work will be used by merchants worldwide, at scale. ## What Success Looks Like **First 3 Months:** - Learn the FunnelKit and Sublium products, data and codebase. - Ship your first AI-powered feature or enhancement from concept to production, with an evaluation baseline in place. - Establish credibility as an engineer who writes reliable code and verifies AI output before it ships. **First 6 Months:** - Own an AI capability end to end, including evaluation, observability and cost control. - Improve how the team builds AI features (prompt standards, guardrails, evaluation practices). - Ship an AI solution or internal tool that becomes a best practice in the company. **First Year:** - Drive cross-product AI improvements and reusable AI components that benefit the whole FunnelKit and Sublium ecosystem. - Be the go-to person for complex AI engineering decisions. - Contribute to hiring and growing AI capability in the team. ## What We Value - **Product-minded engineering:** Understanding the user and the business impact, not only technical elegance. - **Ownership mentality:** Taking responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. - **Simplicity and care:** Maintainable code, sensible failure handling and designs that stay easy to explain. - **Accountability for AI-assisted work:** AI tools speed you up, and you remain responsible for checking everything you ship. - **Continuous improvement:** Always learning, especially in AI. - **Knowledge sharing:** Writing docs, mentoring others and building team capability. ## What We Offer - Opportunity to work on globally used B2B SaaS products with a strong AI mandate. - Competitive compensation (CTC benchmarked for 3+ years of relevant experience, including at least 1 year of production AI work). - High-ownership, low-bureaucracy environment. - Collaborative, product-driven culture with strong emphasis on AI innovation. - Long-term growth and learning opportunities in applied AI engineering. - Technical leadership growth opportunities. **NOTE:** This is a full-time remote role with the company. Please review your answers for clarity and accuracy before you submit. FunnelKit is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Headquarters: US - Remote

Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system. We build technology for independent primary care practices and the physicians, clinicians, and teams who care for their patients every day.

Our platform brings together a clinical-first EHR, intelligent automation, billing, patient engagement, and the workflows that help primary care practices deliver excellent care and build sustainable businesses. The work is consequential: when our products are clear, trustworthy, and well designed, clinicians can spend more time focused on patients and less time fighting their tools.

Primary care is foundational to a healthy healthcare system, yet the technology supporting it is often fragmented, burdensome, and disconnected from the realities of clinical work. At Elation, Design has the opportunity to make the experience of practicing medicine meaningfully better—while helping independent primary care remain strong, sustainable, and human. 

We are seeking a passionate Design leader to drive our design strategy, build a strongly capable Design organization, raise the quality and coherence of the product experience, and use AI-native ways of working to deliver more intuitive, trusted, and impactful experiences for clinicians and practices at scale. If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of AI-native primary care technology, this role is for you.

The opportunity

As Head of Design, you will set the vision, standards, and operating model for Design at Elation. You will lead a talented team of product designers and design partners, work closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and bring a strong design point of view to company strategy and product decisions.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between the strategic and the concrete: defining a coherent experience across a complex product, coaching designers through difficult problems, raising the quality bar, and ensuring the details hold up in the hands of real clinicians.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer and serve as a senior voice in the Product Development organization. The title and scope will be calibrated to the experience and demonstrated impact of the person we hire.

What you’ll do

• Set and communicate a clear design vision for Elation’s product experience, grounded in our clinical-first principles and the realities of primary care.

• Lead and shape an AI-native Design organization with a durable operating model for how designers, agents, and cross-functional teams work together to create higher-quality experiences at greater speed. Elation is already well on this journey, with AI-native product strategy, evolving design systems, and emerging AI-assisted design-review practices.

• Build a high-performing Design function: clarify roles and responsibilities, establish effective operating rhythms, create growth paths, and hire and retain exceptional design talent.

• Partner with the CPO, product leaders, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders to translate company strategy into a focused product experience strategy and roadmap.

• Raise the quality bar across the end-to-end user experience, including research, service design, product strategy, interaction design, visual design, content, accessibility, and customer enablement.

• Strengthen the systems that allow design to scale: principles, patterns, documentation, design systems, research practices, reusable frameworks, and the connection between design artifacts and shipped product. Implement a practical design-review culture that improves decisions early, creates shared standards, protects team velocity, and makes quality everyone’s responsibility.

• Foster deep empathy for clinicians and practice teams by embedding a rigorous culture of user research across product development—engaging directly with clinical and billing experts through co-design, workflow observation, and qualitative and quantitative insights.

• Help teams solve the right problems before they move quickly on the wrong ones. Create clarity in ambiguous spaces and make tradeoffs explicit.

• Partner closely with Engineering to ensure that design intent survives implementation and that the finished experience is reliable, coherent, accessible, and delightful to use.

• Develop designers as leaders and active contributors to product direction—not simply as owners of screens or deliverables.

• Represent the customer and the design perspective in senior leadership discussions, product prioritization, launch decisions, and company-wide conversations about quality.

• Create an environment where designers can do their best work: one that is candid, collaborative, intellectually curious, and accountable for impact.

What success looks like

We will measure success through a combination of customer impact, product quality, organizational health, and operating leverage. In particular, we expect this leader to improve:

• Clinician and practice-team experience, including usability, consistency, and confidence in Elation’s products.

• Design quality and product coherence, with fewer late-stage design issues and less avoidable rework.

• The quality and consistency of customer insight used in product decisions.

• Design team health, retention, hiring, growth, and clarity of ownership.

• Product Development velocity through stronger design systems, review practices, reusable patterns, and AI-native ways of working.

What we’re looking for

• Significant experience leading product design in a complex, multi-surface, or highly regulated environment. Experience in healthcare, health technology, enterprise SaaS, or another domain where trust and workflow quality matter is especially valuable.

• A track record of building, scaling, or materially strengthening a design organization, including hiring, coaching, org design, and talent development.

• Strong product judgment and the ability to connect design decisions to customer outcomes, business strategy, and technical realities.

• Experience partnering effectively with Product and Engineering leaders and influencing decisions beyond the Design function.

• Deep fluency across the UX stack: research, service design, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and design operations.

• A strong point of view on design quality, paired with the humility and communication skills to develop that point of view with others.

• The ability to make complex systems understandable and usable without flattening the nuance that matters.

• A demonstrated commitment to customer-centered, evidence-informed decision making.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make design rationale clear to executives, cross-functional partners, and designers at every level.

• Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure where it is needed, and making thoughtful decisions without waiting for perfect information.

With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.

Product

Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.

The Role

The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.

You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.

• Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
• Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)

• Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
• Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data-driven insights and commercial context
• Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
• Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
• Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non-technical audiences

You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

• Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics-focused role within a software or technology environment
• Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
• Experience working with cross-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
• Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
• Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
• Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
• Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification

What You Can Expect From Us

We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.
